# Adjudication Task — Chapter 418

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃418화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|가끔 누군가의 목숨을 거둘 때마다, 목숨을 구걸하는 적들의 간절한 목소리와 눈빛을 마주할 때마다 그런 의문이 들고는 했다.
  6|
  7|도대체, 왜, 어째서.
  8|
  9|지금껏 스스로가 했던 행동들을 생각하지 않는지. 모든 일에 존재하는 인과를 남에게서 찾으려 하는지.
 10|
 11|‘늦었어.’
 12|
 13|누군가를 죽이고자 했다면 그 반대의 경우도 생각해야 하는 법.
 14|
 15|이미 씨는 뿌려졌고, 마침내 수확의 시간이다.
 16|
 17|나는 우헤이싱의 핏발 선 눈동자를 응시하며 속삭였다.
 18|
 19|“내가 왜 그런 위험을 감수해야 하지?”
 20|
 21|「……!」
 22|
 23|대답을 듣기 위해 던진 물음은 아니었다.
 24|
 25|더 이상 들을 것도, 볼 것도 없다. 나는 망설임 없이 우헤이싱의 목줄기를 잡아 비틀었다.
 26|
 27|우두둑.
 28|
 29|강철도 종잇장처럼 찢어 버리는 악력에 살이 짓이겨지고 뼈가 조각난다.
 30|
 31|부릅뜬 채 굳어 버린 놈의 눈동자에서 마지막 빛이 빠져나갔다.
 32|
 33|버둥거리던 몸이 축 늘어짐과 동시에, 시스템 알림이 울렸다.
 34|
 35|띠링.
 36|
 37|
 38|
 39|- [Lv.135 우헤이싱]을 처치했습니다!
 40|
 41|- 상당량의 경험치를 얻었습니다!
 42|
 43|- 명성치를 얻지 못했습니다. 해당 인물을 처치한 것이 알려진다면 상당한 파장이 예상됩니다!
 44|
 45|
 46|
 47|바로 그때였다. 이십여 미터 밖에서 신형을 일으켜 세운 이정룡이 입을 연 것은.
 48|
 49|“한 치의 망설임도 없구나.”
 50|
 51|나는 숨이 끊긴 우헤이싱을 내던지며 대답했다.
 52|
 53|“죽여야 할 놈이었으니까.”
 54|
 55|“저 아이의 아비가 누구인지 아느냐?”
 56|
 57|“들어 보긴 했지. 수십 년 전쯤 공자 묘에 오함마 내리찍던 놈 중 하나였다고.”
 58|
 59|“그리고 그 어린 홍위병은 자라 중국 정치계의 최고 거물이자 태자당의 우두머리가 되었지. 샤오 양 주석도 감히 그를 어쩌지 못해.”
 60|
 61|“캬, 시벌. 어메이징 대륙이네. 우리나라로 치면 숭례문 방화범이 대통령 된 거 아냐. 안 그래?”
 62|
 63|“이해하려 할 필요는 없다. 다만 한 가지 알아야 할 사실은, 10억 인구 중 가장 강력한 권력자가 쉰이 넘어서야 얻은 외동아들을 네 손으로 죽였다는 게다.”
 64|
 65|“내가? 아니지.”
 66|
 67|나는 천연덕스럽게 웃었다.
 68|
 69|“우헤이싱은 아크 리치와 접전을 벌인 끝에 사망한 거야.”
 70|
 71|“……!”
 72|
 73|“말했잖아, 묘비명도 정해 뒀다고. 나쁜 짱깨, 착한 중국인이 되어 이곳에 잠들다. 물론 그 옆에는 당신 묘비가 있을 거고.”
 74|
 75|알 수 없는 표정으로 나를 바라보던 이정룡이 피식 실소를 흘렸다.
 76|
 77|“교활한 놈이로고.”
 78|
 79|“너희가 짠 시나리오 괜찮더라. 내가 좀 쓰자.”
 80|
 81|“마음대로 하거라. 어차피 네 뜻대로 되진 않을 테니.”
 82|
 83|“글쎄…….”
 84|
 85|나는 널브러진 우헤이싱의 시신을 턱짓으로 가리키며 말을 이었다.
 86|
 87|“지금까지는 어느 정도 내 뜻대로 된 것 같은데?”
 88|
 89|“그래, 그 부분만큼은 나와 같구나.”
 90|
 91|“뭐?”
 92|
 93|눈살을 찌푸린 나를 바라보며, 이정룡이 잔잔하게 웃었다.
 94|
 95|“우헤이싱은 귀가 얇고 입이 가벼운 놈이지. 함께 무언가를 도모하기에는 형편없지만, 그런 놈이라 해도 이용할 구석은 충분하다.”
 96|
 97|“……무슨 개소리야?”
 98|
 99|“말하자면, 이런 뜻이지.”
100|
101|이정룡이 손에 든 무언가를 누르자, 짙은 안개 사이를 뚫고 콘크리트 조각에 닿은 빔이 홀로그램을 띄웠다.
102|
103|10초 남짓한 짧은 홀로그램 영상에는 목숨을 애걸하는 우헤이싱과 한 치의 망설임도 없이 목을 꺾는 내 모습이 그대로 담겨 있었다.
104|
105|“허.”
106|
107|나는 헛웃음과 함께 입을 열었다.
108|
109|“화질 좋네. 누가 보면 오해하기 딱 좋은 영상 같아.”
110|
111|“그렇지. 늦둥이 외아들을 잃은 늙은 아버지라면 특히.”
112|
113|“무편집본으로 보여 줄 생각은?”
114|
115|“마력의 영향 때문인지, 아마 오작동으로 인해 영상의 앞부분이 날아갈 것 같구나.”
116|
117|“그거참, 우연치고는 기가 막히네.”
118|
119|“이걸 본 사람이라면 누구나 기가 막힐 수밖에 없을 터. 평소 헐뜯기 좋아하는 이들은 물론이고, 널 신봉하던 이들조차 돌아서겠지. 네가 그토록 아끼는 사람들도 대중의 비난 속에서 서서히 무너질 게다.”
120|
121|평화 길드, 그리고 엄마와 하연이.
122|
123|이정룡의 말을 듣는 순간 눈앞을 스쳐 지나간 이름과 얼굴들이다.
124|
125|나는 우헤이싱의 시신을 밟으며 걸음을 내디뎠다.
126|
127|저벅.
128|
129|“처음부터 이럴 생각이었나?”
130|
131|“애당초 우헤이싱은 도구였을 뿐, 그 이상의 존재가 될 수 없었다.”
132|
133|저벅.
134|
135|이정룡 역시 나를 향해 걸음을 옮겼다.
136|
137|하지만 그의 전신에서 흘러나오는 기운은 지금까지에 비할 바가 아니었다.
138|
139|그것이 우헤이싱의 죽음에도 이정룡이 평정심을 잃지 않을 수 있었던 이유였다.
140|
141|목적을 달성한 교활한 맹수가, 비로소 숨겨 둔 발톱을 꺼낸 것이다.
142|
143|“빌어먹을, 어쩐지 쉽더라니.”
144|
145|내 푸념에 이정룡이 메마른 웃음을 지었다.
146|
147|“한 가지는 칭찬해 주마. 넌 내 예상을 훨씬 뛰어넘었어.”
148|
149|“마지막으로 묻자. 도대체 왜 이렇게까지 하는 거지?”
150|
151|“너 같은 핏덩이가 짐작이나 할 수 있을까.”
152|
153|저벅.
154|
155|“최 팀장, 아니 최민우가 그렇게 겁났나?”
156|
157|“그 입, 닥치지 못할까.”
158|
159|콰아아아아!
160|
161|순간 밀어닥친 거대한 기파가 안개를 밀어 내고 공간을 장악한다.
162|
163|예리하게 날 선 살기에 피부가 따끔거렸다. 잔잔하던 이정룡의 눈동자 위에는 지금껏 볼 수 없었던 노기가 떠올라 있었다.
164|
165|“오롯이 내 힘으로 얻어 낸 자리다. 평생에 걸쳐 쌓아 올린, 나만의 제국이란 말이다!”
166|
167|그건 꾹꾹 눌러 왔던 분노였고, 실로 오랜만에 표출하는 감정이었다.
168|
169|이정룡은 불길이 쏟아지는 듯한 눈빛으로 나를 노려보며 한 음절, 한 음절 씹듯이 내뱉었다.
170|
171|“그 누구도 무너트릴 수 없다. 너도, 민우 그 아이도, 그리고…… 설령 형님조차도!”
172|
173|형님?
174|
175|난데없이 튀어나온 그 두 글자에 대해 의문을 표할 시간은 내게 주어지지 않았다.
176|
177|저벅.
178|
179|유난히 무겁고 깊은 소리를 남긴 한 걸음.
180|
181|동시에 이정룡의 신형이 물처럼 일렁였다.
182|
183|잔상(殘像)을 남긴 채 사라진 맹수는 어느새 코앞으로 다가와 있었다.
184|
185|쉬이이이잉!
186|
187|눈앞을 가득 메운 빛무리. 나는 허리를 비틀며 백염(白炎)을 휘둘렀다.
188|
189|빛과 화염이 맞닿은 순간, 하늘이 갈라지는 듯한 굉음이 울려 퍼졌다.
190|
191|꽈아아앙!
192|
193|
194|
195|* * *
196|
197|
198|
199|폭발은 거대했다.
200|
201|간신히 버티고 있던 고층 빌딩이 터져 나가듯 무너지고, 유리와 콘크리트가 셀 수도 없을 만큼 작은 조각으로 분해되어 사방을 꿰뚫었다.
202|
203|수십 킬로미터 밖에서도 느껴질 법한 격돌의 여파.
204|
205|연달아 이어지는 붕괴와 굉음 속에서, 나는 발을 뻗었다.
206|
207|쉬익!
208|
209|갈라지는 먼지구름 너머로 허공을 딛고 우뚝 선 한 사람이 모습을 드러냈다.
210|
211|언제나 속을 짐작할 수 없던 투명한 눈동자는 불길을 토해 내고 있었다.
212|
213|“진태경-!”
214|
215|누가 먼저랄 것도 없었다.
216|
217|나는 지면을 부수며 솟구쳤고, 그는 허공을 밟으며 내리꽂혔다.
218|
219|서로를 향해 휘두른 검과 창의 궤적이 정확히 맞닿은 순간, 어마어마한 충격파가 전신을 휩쓸었다.
220|
221|약속이라도 한 것처럼 동시에 튕겨 나간 우리는, 이미 폐허가 된 도시의 구조물을 밟으며 재차 쏘아졌다.
222|
223|쐐애애애액, 꽈앙!
224|
225|굉음과 함께 창날을 흘려 낸 검 끝이 곧장 목젖을 향해 찔러 들어왔다.
226|
227|펑!
228|
229|고개를 틀자 파공성과 함께 잘려 나간 머리카락이 흩날린다.
230|
231|하지만 이것으로 끝이 아니었다.
232|
233|쉬쉬쉬쉭!
234|
235|이정룡의 검이 새하얀 빛이 되어 쏘아졌다.
236|
237|검신을 타고 흘러나온 강기(罡氣)의 그물.
238|
239|눈앞을 가득 메운 빛의 향연에, 나는 단전에 잠들어 있던 모든 공력을 깨웠다.
240|
241|삼 갑자의 열양지기가 들불처럼 일어나 사지백해로 스며든다. 투명한 창날을 타고 솟아오른 푸른 겁화가 용의 꼬리처럼 부드럽게 일렁였다.
242|
243|‘화룡일미(火龍一尾).’
244|
245|후우우웅!
246|
247|단 한 번의 휘두름.
248|
249|부챗살처럼 뻗어 나간 화룡의 꼬리에 쇄도하던 강기의 일부가 사라졌다.
250|
251|이제는 날카로운 발톱으로 헐거워진 그물을 찢어 버릴 차례다.
252|
253|‘천격(天格).’
254|
255|고작 두 초식으로 이루어진 화룡신창(火龍神槍).
256|
257|그러나 화룡신창을 창안한 열화문의 옛 장문인은 천하제일창이라는 수식어를 얻었고, 생애 마지막 순간 자신의 무공에 대한 짤막한 유언을 남겼다.
258|
259|
260|
261|‘일평생을 바쳤지만 완성하지 못한 무공. 그럼에도 천하제일이라 부를 수 있는 창술.’
262|
263|
264|
265|그의 말은 사실이었다.
266|
267|화룡신창은 그런 무공이다. 단 두 초식만으로도 천하제일이라 자부할 수 있는 창술, 그리고…….
268|
269|콰아아아아!
270|
271|전력이 실린 천격이 강기의 그물을 찢고 전방을 휩쓸었다.
272|
273|어찌할 새도 없이 순식간에 들이닥친 화염을 바라보던 이정룡이 힘찬 기합과 함께 검을 내리그었다.
274|
275|“합!”
276|
277|쉬익!
278|
279|검 끝에 화염이 갈라졌다.
280|
281|좌우로 생겨난 불꽃의 길을 따라 화살처럼 쏘아진 신형이 무수한 검격을 쏟아 냈다.
282|
283|슈슈슈슈슉!
284|
285|가슴, 목, 어깨, 팔과 다리…….
286|
287|찰나라고 부를 수 있을 만큼 짧은 시간 속.
288|
289|빛살처럼 휘두르고 베어지는 검의 궤적 앞에서, 나는 문득 경이로움에 사로잡혔다.
290|
291|‘어떻게, 어떻게 이럴 수 있지?’
292|
293|나는 헌터다. 동시에 무인이기도 하다.
294|
295|아니, 어쩌면 플레이어(Player)라는 이름이 어울리는 존재일지도 모른다.
296|
297|무더운 여름날 분리수거장에 버려진 VR 캡슐을 주운 날, 시스템이라는 이름의 새로운 힘을 얻었으니까. 현대와 무림을 아우르는 유일한 존재가 되었으니까.
298|
299|하지만…….
300|
301|쾅!
302|
303|한 치의 군더더기도 없는 움직임, 완벽에 가까운 힘의 조절, 그리고 기의 컨트롤까지.
304|
305|이정룡의 공격을 받아친 나는 내심 감탄했다. 그것은 이정룡이 어떤 사람인가를 떠나, 그가 갖춘 실력에 대한 놀라움이었다.
306|
307|‘이 정도일 줄이야.’
308|
309|초절정의 경지에 오른 뒤, 현대에서 나를 상대할 만한 사람은 많지 않을 거라 생각했다.
310|
311|그리고 사천에 와서 여러 S급 헌터들을 만난 후 그런 생각은 더더욱 굳어졌다.
312|
313|그들 개개인이 품은 기운이 아무리 크다 할지라도, 이곳에는 무공이 존재하지 않으니까.
314|

[P66]

[P67]
“Damn it. No wonder it seemed so easy.”

[P68]

[P69]
“I will praise you for one thing. You far exceeded my expectations.”

[P70]
“Let me ask you one last time. Why are you going this far?”

[P71]
“Could a young pup like you possibly understand?”

[P72]
*Step.*

[P73]
“Were you really that afraid of Team Leader Choi—no, Choi Minwoo?”

[P74]
“Will you not shut that mouth of yours?”

[P75]
*Kuwaaaaaaaang!*

[P76]
A massive wave of qi surged outward, driving back the fog and seizing control of the space around us.

[P77]
The razor-sharp killing intent made my skin prickle. Anger unlike anything I had ever seen rose in Lee Jungryong’s once-placid eyes.

[P78]
“I won my place entirely through my own strength. It is my empire, built over the course of my entire life!”

[P79]
It was anger he had kept buried, an emotion he had not allowed himself to show in a very long time.

[P80]
Lee Jungryong glared at me with fire blazing in his eyes and ground out each syllable.

[P81]
“No one can bring it down. Not you, not that boy Minwoo, and… not even my hyung!”

[P82]
*Hyung?*

[P83]
I was given no time to question the unexpected word.

[P84]
*Step.*

[P85]
A single step rang out, unusually heavy and deep.

[P86]
At the same time, Lee Jungryong’s form rippled like water.

[P87]
The beast vanished, leaving behind an afterimage, and appeared right in front of me.

[P88]
*Fweeeeeeeeng!*

[P89]
A mass of light filled my vision. I twisted at the waist and swung White Flame.

[P90]
The instant light and flame collided, a thunderous roar erupted as though the sky itself had split apart.

[P91]
*Kwaaang!*

[P92]
* * *

[P93]
The explosion was enormous.

[P94]
A high-rise that had barely remained standing collapsed as though it had burst apart. Glass and concrete shattered into countless tiny fragments that shot in every direction.

[P95]
The impact of the clash could likely be felt from dozens of kilometers away.

[P96]
Amid the successive collapses and thunderous booms, I launched myself forward.

[P97]
*Fwish!*

[P98]
Beyond the dust cloud splitting apart before me, a man stood poised in midair as though on solid ground.

[P99]
His clear eyes, always impossible to read, now blazed with fury.

[P100]
“Jin Taekyung!”

[P101]
Neither of us waited for the other.

[P102]
I shattered the ground as I sprang upward, while he stepped on empty air and plunged toward me.

[P103]
The sword and spear we swung at each other collided dead-on, and an immense shock wave engulfed us both.

[P104]
Hurled backward at the same instant as though we had planned it, we kicked off the structures of the already-ruined city and shot toward each other again.

[P105]
*Shweeeeeek—Kwang!*

[P106]
With a thunderous boom, Lee Jungryong’s sword deflected my spearhead and thrust straight toward my throat.

[P107]
*Boom!*

[P108]
I jerked my head aside. Air shrieked past, and severed strands of hair scattered behind me.

[P109]
But it wasn’t over.

[P110]
*Shwish-shwish-shwish!*

[P111]
Lee Jungryong’s sword shot forward as a streak of pure white light.

[P112]
A net of Force streamed from the blade.

[P113]
Faced with that spectacle of light filling my vision, I awakened all the internal energy sleeping within my dantian.

[P114]
Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi rose like wildfire and surged through every limb and meridian. Blue hellfire blazed along the transparent spearhead, rippling smoothly like a dragon’s tail.

[P115]
*Fire Dragon’s Single Tail.*

[P116]
*Whoooooosh!*

[P117]
A single swing.

[P118]
The fire dragon’s tail fanned outward, erasing part of the onrushing net of Force.

[P119]
Now it was time to tear the loosened net apart with sharpened claws.

[P120]
*Heavenly Strike.*

[P121]
The Fire Dragon Divine Spear consisted of only two forms.

[P122]
Yet the ancient Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan who created it had earned the title of the greatest spearman under heaven. In the final moments of his life, he left behind a brief testament concerning his martial art.

[P123]
> “A martial art I devoted my entire life to, yet failed to complete. Even so, a spear art worthy of being called the greatest under heaven.”

[P124]
His words were true.

[P125]
That was the Fire Dragon Divine Spear. A spear art that could proudly call itself the greatest under heaven with only two forms, and…

[P126]
*Kuwaaaaaang!*

[P127]
Heavenly Strike, unleashed with all my power, tore through the net of Force and swept across everything ahead of it.

[P128]
The flames were upon Lee Jungryong before he had any chance to react. Watching them rush toward him, he brought his sword down with a forceful shout.

[P129]
“Ha!”

[P130]
*Fwish!*

[P131]
The flames split at the tip of his sword.

[P132]
His form shot forward like an arrow through the paths of fire opening to either side, unleashing countless sword strikes.

[P133]
*Shu-shu-shu-shu-shuk!*

[P134]
Chest, throat, shoulder, arms, legs…

[P135]
Within a span of time short enough to be called an instant—

[P136]
Faced with arcs of swordlight slashing toward me like rays of light, I was suddenly seized by wonder.

[P137]
*How? How is this possible?*

[P138]
I was a Hunter. At the same time, I was a martial artist.

[P139]
No. Perhaps *Player* was the name that suited me best.

[P140]
On a sweltering summer day, I had picked up a discarded VR capsule at a recycling station and gained a new power called the System. I had become the only person to stand astride both the modern world and Murim.

[P141]
But still…

[P142]
*Boom!*

[P143]
Not a single wasted movement. Near-perfect control over his strength. Even his manipulation of qi was flawless.

[P144]
After parrying Lee Jungryong’s attack, I found myself admiring him. It had nothing to do with what kind of person he was. I was simply stunned by his skill.

[P145]
*So he was this strong.*

[P146]
After reaching the Supreme Peak realm, I had thought there could not be many people in the modern world capable of matching me.

[P147]
After coming to Sichuan and meeting several S-rank Hunters, that belief had only grown stronger.

[P148]
No matter how much energy each of them possessed, martial arts did not exist here.

[P149]
Hunters might fight efficiently, but when it came to using qi efficiently, they were practically illiterate.

[P150]
Lee Jungryong? I knew he had learned what the modern world called a mana cultivation method, but I had assumed he would not be much different.

[P151]
Now I realized the truth.

[P152]
My arrogance had led me to the wrong conclusion.

[P153]
*Slash!*

[P154]
My thigh suddenly felt cool. A heartbeat later, pain as hot as fire followed.

[P155]
But why did my mind clear and my vision sharpen, as though I had just awakened from a long sleep?

[P156]
*Slash, slash, slash!*

[P157]
My arm. My calf. The back of my neck.

[P158]
Blood sprayed out, and the qi carried through his Force disrupted the flow of my internal energy.

[P159]
As I staggered, I looked at Lee Jungryong’s face while he continued raining sword strikes down upon me.

[P160]
His forehead glistened with sweat. His eyes held the certainty of victory, and a smile hung at the corners of his mouth.

[P161]
*Ah. I don’t like this.*

[P162]
I didn’t like that smile. I didn’t like the fact that a man like him possessed this much power.

[P163]
Something surged inside me, and I swung White Flame.

[P164]
*Kwaang!*

[P165]
The first exchange.

[P166]
Blood flowed from the cuts inflicted earlier, and pain spread through me. Without a word, I thrust my spear forward again.

[P167]
Lee Jungryong, who had retreated a step, met me with a calm smile.

[P168]
*Boom!*

[P169]
The second exchange.

[P170]
Lee Jungryong retreated two steps and stared at me in surprise.

[P171]
*He still had that much strength left?*

[P172]
The thought was written plainly across his face.

[P173]
*Of course I do.*

[P174]
I muttered inwardly, adjusted my grip on the spear, ignored the faint pain spreading through me, and stepped forward.

[P175]
*Boom! Boom! Kwaang!*

[P176]
Three times. Four times. Five times.

[P177]
Each time spear and sword collided and thunderous roars erupted, Lee Jungryong’s expression hardened further.

[P178]
The smile at the corners of his mouth had vanished long ago.

[P179]
“You bastard…!”

[P180]
Hearing that growling shout instead of his usual voice, soft as a cat’s paw, made me laugh for some reason.

[P181]
Intoxicated by my own strength, I had underestimated his skill and made a foolish mistake.

[P182]
But Lee Jungryong had done the same.

[P183]
The claws he had bared were certainly strong and sharp, but they were not enough to kill me.

[P184]
“Jungryong.”

[P185]
I drew a deep breath, and stale air and a foul stench flooded my lungs.

[P186]
Even so, I felt refreshed, as though something inside me had finally opened wide.

[P187]
Yes. Now I understood.

[P188]
“Let’s clip those claws.”

[P189]
Lee Jungryong would die here today.

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

This call is isolated, non-interactive, and tool-free. The packet already contains the Korean source, both complete English versions, glossary matches, rules, and every numbered hunk. Do not call tools, search the repository, or read files. Do not announce a plan.

The first editor (SOL) has already rewritten the accepted English (BASELINE) for fluency. Default is `SOL`. Take `BASE` only when SOL is actually unfaithful. Write `REPAIR` only when **both** BASE and SOL are unfaithful.

## Default

Choose `SOL` unless a veto below fires.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). If SOL already naturalized Korean syntax (`이 혁무진` → “I, Hyuk Mujin”), keep SOL. Do not reproduce Korean word order.

**Literal closeness to Korean wording is not fidelity.** Preserve the source’s meaning and effect in natural English.

## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action
* a different English idiom than the Korean joke (`까발리다` ≠ “gives someone away”; `넉살` ≠ “banter”)
* a rebuilt joke whose comic machine BASE already has (`얼마나 …는지 …겠다` must stay a simple exaggeration: “snored so loudly even my mother in Ilsan probably heard him,” not “You had to wonder how loudly…”)
* dropped image, attitude, or timing
* SOL replaces an established project rendering, System label, or Markdown convention with an unsupported synonym
* SOL stamps `hyung` (or another kinship title) onto every narrative name when BASE already uses the name and the Korean `형` is ordinary reference, not a vocative or a topical joke (`진호 형` → Jinho in narration)

Do not veto SOL for being informal. Do not veto SOL to “clarify” slang. Do not veto SOL merely because BASELINE is already understandable.

Example: `겹경사가 따로 없다` means two good things **together** (double blessing). `따로` is not “separate.” If BASE says “entirely separate stroke of luck” and SOL says “unexpected windfall,” `REPAIR` to stacked luck.

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.
- Never read `characters/spoilers/` during drafting. Reviewers may consult one relevant sealed profile only for a specific unresolved continuity issue after the draft is complete.
- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.

Sometimes, when I took someone’s life—when I faced the desperate voices and pleading eyes of enemies begging to be spared—I found myself wondering.

[P3]
*Why? Why on earth?*

[P4]
Why didn’t they stop to think about what they themselves had done? Why did they always look to others for the cause of everything that befell them?

[P5]
*Too late.*

[P6]
If you tried to kill someone, you had to consider the possibility that you might be killed instead.

[P7]
The seeds had already been sown. At last, it was time to reap the harvest.

[P8]
I stared into Wu Heixing’s bloodshot eyes and whispered,

[P9]
“Why should I take that kind of risk?”

[P10]
“…!”

[P11]
I hadn’t asked because I wanted an answer.

[P12]
There was nothing more to hear or see. Without hesitation, I grabbed Wu Heixing by the neck and twisted.

[P13]
*Crunch.*

[P14]
Flesh crumpled and bone splintered beneath a grip strong enough to tear steel like paper.

[P15]
The last light faded from his wide, frozen eyes.

[P16]
The instant his struggling body went limp, a System notification rang out.

[P17]
> **System**
>
> - Defeated **Lv. 135 Wu Heixing**!
> - Gained a substantial amount of **EXP**!
> - Gained no **Fame**. If it becomes known that you killed this person, significant repercussions are expected!

[P18]
That was when Lee Jungryong rose to his feet more than twenty meters away and spoke.

[P19]
“Not even a moment’s hesitation.”

[P20]
I tossed Wu Heixing’s lifeless body aside.

[P21]
“He needed to die.”

[P22]
“Do you know who that boy’s father is?”

[P23]
“I’ve heard of him. Apparently, he was one of the men who took a sledgehammer to Confucius’s tomb decades ago.”[^1]

[P24]
“And that young Red Guard grew up to become the most powerful man in Chinese politics and the leader of the Crown Prince Party. Even Chairman Xiao Yang does not dare touch him.”

[P25]
“Damn. What a fucking amazing continent. In our country, that’d be like the arsonist who burned down Sungnyemun becoming President. Don’t you think?”

[P26]
“There is no need to understand it. But there is one fact you must know. With your own hands, you killed the only son that the most powerful man among one billion people had after turning fifty.”

[P27]
“Me? No, I didn’t.”

[P28]
I smiled shamelessly.

[P29]
“Wu Heixing died after a fierce battle with the Arch Lich.”

[P30]
“…!”

[P31]
“I told you, I already picked out his epitaph. *Here lies a bad chink who became a good Chinese man.* Of course, your gravestone will be right beside his.”

[P32]
Lee Jungryong stared at me with an inscrutable expression, then let out a quiet laugh.

[P33]
“You’re a crafty one.”

[P34]
“I liked the scenario you two came up with. Let me borrow it.”

[P35]
“Do as you please. It will not go the way you wish regardless.”

[P36]
“Maybe…”

[P37]
I gestured toward Wu Heixing’s sprawled corpse with my chin.

[P38]
“So far, things seem to have gone more or less my way.”

[P39]
“Yes. In that respect, you and I are alike.”

[P40]
“What?”

[P41]
As I frowned, Lee Jungryong gave me a faint smile.

[P42]
“Wu Heixing was easily swayed and loose-lipped. A terrible man to conspire with, but even someone like him had his uses.”

[P43]
“…What the fuck are you talking about?”

[P44]
“This is what I mean.”

[P45]
Lee Jungryong pressed something in his hand. A beam pierced the thick fog and struck a chunk of concrete, projecting a hologram above it.

[P46]
The short video, barely ten seconds long, showed Wu Heixing begging for his life—and me breaking his neck without a moment’s hesitation.

[P47]
“Huh.”

[P48]
I let out a hollow laugh.

[P49]
“Nice image quality. Perfect for giving people the wrong idea.”

[P50]
“Indeed. Especially an old father who has lost his only son, born late in life.”

[P51]
“Planning to show him the unedited version?”

[P52]
“Perhaps due to magical interference, a malfunction will cause the beginning of the recording to disappear.”

[P53]
“That’s one hell of a coincidence.”

[P54]
“Anyone who sees it will be appalled. Not only those who delight in tearing others down, but even those who worshipped you will turn against you. And the people you cherish so dearly will slowly crumble beneath the public’s condemnation.”

[P55]
The Peace Guild.

[P56]
Mom and Hayeon.

[P57]
Their names and faces flashed before my eyes the moment I heard Lee Jungryong’s words.

[P58]
I stepped forward, planting my foot on Wu Heixing’s corpse.

[P59]
*Step.*

[P60]
“Was this your plan from the beginning?”

[P61]
“Wu Heixing was merely a tool from the start. He could never have been anything more.”

[P62]
*Step.*

[P63]
Lee Jungryong began walking toward me as well.

[P64]
But the qi pouring from his entire body was on a completely different level from anything he had shown before.

[P65]
That was why Wu Heixing’s death had failed to disturb his composure.

[P66]
The cunning beast had achieved its objective. Now, at last, it had bared the claws it had kept hidden.

[P67]
“Damn it. No wonder it seemed so easy.”

[P68]
Lee Jungryong gave a dry laugh at my complaint.

[P69]
“I will praise you for one thing. You far exceeded my expectations.”

[P70]
“Let me ask you one last time. Why are you going this far?”

[P71]
“Could a young pup like you possibly understand?”

[P72]
*Step.*

[P73]
“Were you really that afraid of Team Leader Choi—no, Choi Minwoo?”

[P74]
“Will you not shut that mouth of yours?”

[P75]
*Kuwaaaaaaaang!*

[P76]
A massive wave of qi surged outward, driving back the fog and seizing control of the space around us.

[P77]
The razor-sharp killing intent made my skin prickle. Anger unlike anything I had ever seen rose in Lee Jungryong’s once-placid eyes.

[P78]
“I won my place entirely through my own strength. It is my empire, built over the course of my entire life!”

[P79]
It was anger he had kept buried, an emotion he had not allowed himself to show in a very long time.

[P80]
Lee Jungryong glared at me with fire blazing in his eyes and ground out each syllable.

[P81]
“No one can bring it down. Not you, not that boy Minwoo, and… not even my hyung!”

[P82]
*Hyung?*

[P83]
I was given no time to question the unexpected word.

[P84]
*Step.*

[P85]
A single step rang out, unusually heavy and deep.

[P86]
At the same time, Lee Jungryong’s form rippled like water.

[P87]
The beast vanished, leaving behind an afterimage, and appeared right in front of me.

[P88]
*Fweeeeeeeeng!*

[P89]
A mass of light filled my vision. I twisted at the waist and swung White Flame.

[P90]
The instant light and flame collided, a thunderous roar erupted as though the sky itself had split apart.

[P91]
*Kwaaang!*

[P92]
* * *

[P93]
The explosion was enormous.

[P94]
A high-rise that had barely remained standing collapsed as though it had burst apart. Glass and concrete shattered into countless tiny fragments that shot in every direction.

[P95]
The impact of the clash could likely be felt from dozens of kilometers away.

[P96]
Amid the successive collapses and thunderous booms, I launched myself forward.

[P97]
*Fwish!*

[P98]
Beyond the dust cloud splitting apart before me, a man stood poised in midair as though on solid ground.

[P99]
His clear eyes, always impossible to read, now blazed with fury.

[P100]
“Jin Taekyung!”

[P101]
Neither of us waited for the other.

[P102]
I shattered the ground as I sprang upward, while he stepped on empty air and plunged toward me.

[P103]
The sword and spear we swung at each other collided dead-on, and an immense shock wave engulfed us both.

[P104]
Hurled backward at the same instant as though we had planned it, we kicked off the structures of the already-ruined city and shot toward each other again.

[P105]
*Shweeeeeek—Kwang!*

[P106]
With a thunderous boom, Lee Jungryong’s sword deflected my spearhead and thrust straight toward my throat.

[P107]
*Boom!*

[P108]
I jerked my head aside. Air shrieked past, and severed strands of hair scattered behind me.

[P109]
But it wasn’t over.

[P110]
*Shwish-shwish-shwish!*

[P111]
Lee Jungryong’s sword shot forward as a streak of pure white light.

[P112]
A net of Force streamed from the blade.

[P113]
Faced with that spectacle of light filling my vision, I awakened all the internal energy sleeping within my dantian.

[P114]
Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi rose like wildfire and surged through every limb and meridian. Blue hellfire blazed along the transparent spearhead, rippling smoothly like a dragon’s tail.

[P115]
*Fire Dragon’s Single Tail.*

[P116]
*Whoooooosh!*

[P117]
A single swing.

[P118]
The fire dragon’s tail fanned outward, erasing part of the onrushing net of Force.

[P119]
Now it was time to tear the loosened net apart with sharpened claws.

[P120]
*Heavenly Strike.*

[P121]
The Fire Dragon Divine Spear consisted of only two forms.

[P122]
Yet the ancient Sect Leader of the Fire Gate Clan who created it had earned the title of the greatest spearman under heaven. In the final moments of his life, he left behind a brief testament concerning his martial art.

[P123]
> “A martial art I devoted my entire life to, yet failed to complete. Even so, a spear art worthy of being called the greatest under heaven.”

[P124]
His words were true.

[P125]
That was the Fire Dragon Divine Spear. A spear art that could proudly call itself the greatest under heaven with only two forms, and…

[P126]
*Kuwaaaaaang!*

[P127]
Heavenly Strike, unleashed with all my power, tore through the net of Force and swept across everything ahead of it.

[P128]
The flames were upon Lee Jungryong before he had any chance to react. Watching them rush toward him, he brought his sword down with a forceful shout.

[P129]
“Ha!”

[P130]
*Fwish!*

[P131]
The flames split at the tip of his sword.

[P132]
His form shot forward like an arrow through the paths of fire opening to either side, unleashing countless sword strikes.

[P133]
*Shu-shu-shu-shu-shuk!*

[P134]
Chest, throat, shoulder, arms, legs…

[P135]
Within a span of time short enough to be called an instant—

[P136]
Faced with arcs of swordlight slashing toward me like rays of light, I was suddenly seized by wonder.

[P137]
*How? How is this possible?*

[P138]
I was a Hunter. At the same time, I was a martial artist.

[P139]
No. Perhaps *Player* was the name that suited me best.

[P140]
On a sweltering summer day, I had picked up a discarded VR capsule at a recycling station and gained a new power called the System. I had become the only person to stand astride both the modern world and Murim.

[P141]
But still…

[P142]
*Boom!*

[P143]
Not a single wasted movement. Near-perfect control over his strength. Even his manipulation of qi was flawless.

[P144]
After parrying Lee Jungryong’s attack, I found myself admiring him. It had nothing to do with what kind of person he was. I was simply stunned by his skill.

[P145]
*So he was this strong.*

[P146]
After reaching the Supreme Peak realm, I had thought there could not be many people in the modern world capable of matching me.

[P147]
After coming to Sichuan and meeting several S-rank Hunters, that belief had only grown stronger.

[P148]
No matter how much energy each of them possessed, martial arts did not exist here.

[P149]
Hunters might fight efficiently, but when it came to using qi efficiently, they were practically illiterate.

[P150]
Lee Jungryong? I knew he had learned what the modern world called a mana cultivation method, but I had assumed he would not be much different.

[P151]
Now I realized the truth.

[P152]
My arrogance had led me to the wrong conclusion.

[P153]
*Slash!*

[P154]
My thigh suddenly felt cool. A heartbeat later, pain as hot as fire followed.

[P155]
But why did my mind clear and my vision sharpen, as though I had just awakened from a long sleep?

[P156]
*Slash, slash, slash!*

[P157]
My arm. My calf. The back of my neck.

[P158]
Blood sprayed out, and the qi carried through his Force disrupted the flow of my internal energy.

[P159]
As I staggered, I looked at Lee Jungryong’s face while he continued raining sword strikes down upon me.

[P160]
His forehead glistened with sweat. His eyes held the certainty of victory, and a smile hung at the corners of his mouth.

[P161]
*Ah. I don’t like this.*

[P162]
I didn’t like that smile. I didn’t like the fact that a man like him possessed this much power.

[P163]
Something surged inside me, and I swung White Flame.

[P164]
*Kwaang!*

[P165]
The first exchange.

[P166]
Blood flowed from the cuts inflicted earlier, and pain spread through me. Without a word, I thrust my spear forward again.

[P167]
Lee Jungryong, who had retreated a step, met me with a calm smile.

[P168]
*Boom!*

[P169]
The second exchange.

[P170]
Lee Jungryong retreated two steps and stared at me in surprise.

[P171]
*He still had that much strength left?*

[P172]
The thought was written plainly across his face.

[P173]
*Of course I do.*

[P174]
I muttered inwardly, adjusted my grip on the spear, ignored the faint pain spreading through me, and stepped forward.

[P175]
*Boom! Boom! Kwaang!*

[P176]
Three times. Four times. Five times.

[P177]
Each time spear and sword collided and thunderous roars erupted, Lee Jungryong’s expression hardened further.

[P178]
The smile at the corners of his mouth had vanished long ago.

[P179]
“You bastard…!”

[P180]
Hearing that growling shout instead of his usual voice, soft as a cat’s paw, made me laugh for some reason.

[P181]
Intoxicated by my own strength, I had underestimated his skill and made a foolish mistake.

[P182]
But Lee Jungryong had done the same.

[P183]
The claws he had bared were certainly strong and sharp, but they were not enough to kill me.

[P184]
“Jungryong.”

[P185]
I drew a deep breath, and stale air and a foul stench flooded my lungs.

[P186]
Even so, I felt refreshed, as though something inside me had finally opened wide.

[P187]
Yes. Now I understood.

[P188]
“Let’s clip those claws.”

[P189]
Lee Jungryong would die here today.

[P190]
[^1]: The reference is to the Red Guards’ attack on Confucius’s tomb during the Cultural Revolution.

## Adjudicator rules

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

This call is isolated, non-interactive, and tool-free. The packet already contains the Korean source, both complete English versions, glossary matches, rules, and every numbered hunk. Do not call tools, search the repository, or read files. Do not announce a plan.

The first editor (SOL) has already rewritten the accepted English (BASELINE) for fluency. Default is `SOL`. Take `BASE` only when SOL is actually unfaithful. Write `REPAIR` only when **both** BASE and SOL are unfaithful.

## Default

Choose `SOL` unless a veto below fires.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). If SOL already naturalized Korean syntax (`이 혁무진` → “I, Hyuk Mujin”), keep SOL. Do not reproduce Korean word order.

**Literal closeness to Korean wording is not fidelity.** Preserve the source’s meaning and effect in natural English.

## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action
* a different English idiom than the Korean joke (`까발리다` ≠ “gives someone away”; `넉살` ≠ “banter”)
* a rebuilt joke whose comic machine BASE already has (`얼마나 …는지 …겠다` must stay a simple exaggeration: “snored so loudly even my mother in Ilsan probably heard him,” not “You had to wonder how loudly…”)
* dropped image, attitude, or timing
* SOL replaces an established project rendering, System label, or Markdown convention with an unsupported synonym
* SOL stamps `hyung` (or another kinship title) onto every narrative name when BASE already uses the name and the Korean `형` is ordinary reference, not a vocative or a topical joke (`진호 형` → Jinho in narration)

Do not veto SOL for being informal. Do not veto SOL to “clarify” slang. Do not veto SOL merely because BASELINE is already understandable.

## `REPAIR` only when both fail

Example: `겹경사가 따로 없다` means two good things **together** (double blessing). `따로` is not “separate.” If BASE says “entirely separate stroke of luck” and SOL says “unexpected windfall,” `REPAIR` to stacked luck.

Do not `REPAIR` a working SOL line. Do not invent a third style because you prefer it.

For `REPAIR`, write the smallest complete replacement needed for that hunk. It must be natural English and fully source-faithful.

## Glossary

Korean **keys** are binding unless the source uses that string in a different ordinary-language sense. Glossary **English** is not a license for a calque (`presiding chair`). If SOL is a natural recast of the same sense, keep SOL.

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.

# Adjudication Task — Chapter 418

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃418화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|가끔 누군가의 목숨을 거둘 때마다, 목숨을 구걸하는 적들의 간절한 목소리와 눈빛을 마주할 때마다 그런 의문이 들고는 했다.
  6|
  7|도대체, 왜, 어째서.
  8|
  9|지금껏 스스로가 했던 행동들을 생각하지 않는지. 모든 일에 존재하는 인과를 남에게서 찾으려 하는지.
 10|
 11|‘늦었어.’
 12|
 13|누군가를 죽이고자 했다면 그 반대의 경우도 생각해야 하는 법.
 14|
 15|이미 씨는 뿌려졌고, 마침내 수확의 시간이다.
 16|
 17|나는 우헤이싱의 핏발 선 눈동자를 응시하며 속삭였다.
 18|
 19|“내가 왜 그런 위험을 감수해야 하지?”
 20|
 21|「……!」
 22|
 23|대답을 듣기 위해 던진 물음은 아니었다.
 24|
 25|더 이상 들을 것도, 볼 것도 없다. 나는 망설임 없이 우헤이싱의 목줄기를 잡아 비틀었다.
 26|
 27|우두둑.
 28|
 29|강철도 종잇장처럼 찢어 버리는 악력에 살이 짓이겨지고 뼈가 조각난다.
 30|
 31|부릅뜬 채 굳어 버린 놈의 눈동자에서 마지막 빛이 빠져나갔다.
 32|
 33|버둥거리던 몸이 축 늘어짐과 동시에, 시스템 알림이 울렸다.
 34|
 35|띠링.
 36|
 37|
 38|
 39|- [Lv.135 우헤이싱]을 처치했습니다!
 40|
 41|- 상당량의 경험치를 얻었습니다!
 42|
 43|- 명성치를 얻지 못했습니다. 해당 인물을 처치한 것이 알려진다면 상당한 파장이 예상됩니다!
 44|
 45|
 46|
 47|바로 그때였다. 이십여 미터 밖에서 신형을 일으켜 세운 이정룡이 입을 연 것은.
 48|
 49|“한 치의 망설임도 없구나.”
 50|
 51|나는 숨이 끊긴 우헤이싱을 내던지며 대답했다.
 52|
 53|“죽여야 할 놈이었으니까.”
 54|
 55|“저 아이의 아비가 누구인지 아느냐?”
 56|
 57|“들어 보긴 했지. 수십 년 전쯤 공자 묘에 오함마 내리찍던 놈 중 하나였다고.”
 58|
 59|“그리고 그 어린 홍위병은 자라 중국 정치계의 최고 거물이자 태자당의 우두머리가 되었지. 샤오 양 주석도 감히 그를 어쩌지 못해.”
 60|
 61|“캬, 시벌. 어메이징 대륙이네. 우리나라로 치면 숭례문 방화범이 대통령 된 거 아냐. 안 그래?”
 62|
 63|“이해하려 할 필요는 없다. 다만 한 가지 알아야 할 사실은, 10억 인구 중 가장 강력한 권력자가 쉰이 넘어서야 얻은 외동아들을 네 손으로 죽였다는 게다.”
 64|
 65|“내가? 아니지.”
 66|
 67|나는 천연덕스럽게 웃었다.
 68|
 69|“우헤이싱은 아크 리치와 접전을 벌인 끝에 사망한 거야.”
 70|
 71|“……!”
 72|
 73|“말했잖아, 묘비명도 정해 뒀다고. 나쁜 짱깨, 착한 중국인이 되어 이곳에 잠들다. 물론 그 옆에는 당신 묘비가 있을 거고.”
 74|
 75|알 수 없는 표정으로 나를 바라보던 이정룡이 피식 실소를 흘렸다.
 76|
 77|“교활한 놈이로고.”
 78|
 79|“너희가 짠 시나리오 괜찮더라. 내가 좀 쓰자.”
 80|
 81|“마음대로 하거라. 어차피 네 뜻대로 되진 않을 테니.”
 82|
 83|“글쎄…….”
 84|
 85|나는 널브러진 우헤이싱의 시신을 턱짓으로 가리키며 말을 이었다.
 86|
 87|“지금까지는 어느 정도 내 뜻대로 된 것 같은데?”
 88|
 89|“그래, 그 부분만큼은 나와 같구나.”
 90|
 91|“뭐?”
 92|
 93|눈살을 찌푸린 나를 바라보며, 이정룡이 잔잔하게 웃었다.
 94|
 95|“우헤이싱은 귀가 얇고 입이 가벼운 놈이지. 함께 무언가를 도모하기에는 형편없지만, 그런 놈이라 해도 이용할 구석은 충분하다.”
 96|
 97|“……무슨 개소리야?”
 98|
 99|“말하자면, 이런 뜻이지.”
100|
101|이정룡이 손에 든 무언가를 누르자, 짙은 안개 사이를 뚫고 콘크리트 조각에 닿은 빔이 홀로그램을 띄웠다.
102|
103|10초 남짓한 짧은 홀로그램 영상에는 목숨을 애걸하는 우헤이싱과 한 치의 망설임도 없이 목을 꺾는 내 모습이 그대로 담겨 있었다.
104|
105|“허.”
106|
107|나는 헛웃음과 함께 입을 열었다.
108|
109|“화질 좋네. 누가 보면 오해하기 딱 좋은 영상 같아.”
110|
111|“그렇지. 늦둥이 외아들을 잃은 늙은 아버지라면 특히.”
112|
113|“무편집본으로 보여 줄 생각은?”
114|
115|“마력의 영향 때문인지, 아마 오작동으로 인해 영상의 앞부분이 날아갈 것 같구나.”
116|
117|“그거참, 우연치고는 기가 막히네.”
118|
119|“이걸 본 사람이라면 누구나 기가 막힐 수밖에 없을 터. 평소 헐뜯기 좋아하는 이들은 물론이고, 널 신봉하던 이들조차 돌아서겠지. 네가 그토록 아끼는 사람들도 대중의 비난 속에서 서서히 무너질 게다.”
120|
121|평화 길드, 그리고 엄마와 하연이.
122|
123|이정룡의 말을 듣는 순간 눈앞을 스쳐 지나간 이름과 얼굴들이다.
124|
125|나는 우헤이싱의 시신을 밟으며 걸음을 내디뎠다.
126|
127|저벅.
128|
129|“처음부터 이럴 생각이었나?”
130|
131|“애당초 우헤이싱은 도구였을 뿐, 그 이상의 존재가 될 수 없었다.”
132|
133|저벅.
134|
135|이정룡 역시 나를 향해 걸음을 옮겼다.
136|
137|하지만 그의 전신에서 흘러나오는 기운은 지금까지에 비할 바가 아니었다.
138|
139|그것이 우헤이싱의 죽음에도 이정룡이 평정심을 잃지 않을 수 있었던 이유였다.
140|
141|목적을 달성한 교활한 맹수가, 비로소 숨겨 둔 발톱을 꺼낸 것이다.
142|
143|“빌어먹을, 어쩐지 쉽더라니.”
144|
145|내 푸념에 이정룡이 메마른 웃음을 지었다.
146|
147|“한 가지는 칭찬해 주마. 넌 내 예상을 훨씬 뛰어넘었어.”
148|
149|“마지막으로 묻자. 도대체 왜 이렇게까지 하는 거지?”
150|
151|“너 같은 핏덩이가 짐작이나 할 수 있을까.”
152|
153|저벅.
154|
155|“최 팀장, 아니 최민우가 그렇게 겁났나?”
156|
157|“그 입, 닥치지 못할까.”
158|
159|콰아아아아!
160|
161|순간 밀어닥친 거대한 기파가 안개를 밀어 내고 공간을 장악한다.
162|
163|예리하게 날 선 살기에 피부가 따끔거렸다. 잔잔하던 이정룡의 눈동자 위에는 지금껏 볼 수 없었던 노기가 떠올라 있었다.
164|
165|“오롯이 내 힘으로 얻어 낸 자리다. 평생에 걸쳐 쌓아 올린, 나만의 제국이란 말이다!”
166|
167|그건 꾹꾹 눌러 왔던 분노였고, 실로 오랜만에 표출하는 감정이었다.
168|
169|이정룡은 불길이 쏟아지는 듯한 눈빛으로 나를 노려보며 한 음절, 한 음절 씹듯이 내뱉었다.
170|
171|“그 누구도 무너트릴 수 없다. 너도, 민우 그 아이도, 그리고…… 설령 형님조차도!”
172|
173|형님?
174|
175|난데없이 튀어나온 그 두 글자에 대해 의문을 표할 시간은 내게 주어지지 않았다.
176|
177|저벅.
178|
179|유난히 무겁고 깊은 소리를 남긴 한 걸음.
180|
181|동시에 이정룡의 신형이 물처럼 일렁였다.
182|
183|잔상(殘像)을 남긴 채 사라진 맹수는 어느새 코앞으로 다가와 있었다.
184|
185|쉬이이이잉!
186|
187|눈앞을 가득 메운 빛무리. 나는 허리를 비틀며 백염(白炎)을 휘둘렀다.
188|
189|빛과 화염이 맞닿은 순간, 하늘이 갈라지는 듯한 굉음이 울려 퍼졌다.
190|
191|꽈아아앙!
192|
193|
194|
195|* * *
196|
197|
198|
199|폭발은 거대했다.
200|
201|간신히 버티고 있던 고층 빌딩이 터져 나가듯 무너지고, 유리와 콘크리트가 셀 수도 없을 만큼 작은 조각으로 분해되어 사방을 꿰뚫었다.
202|
203|수십 킬로미터 밖에서도 느껴질 법한 격돌의 여파.
204|
205|연달아 이어지는 붕괴와 굉음 속에서, 나는 발을 뻗었다.
206|
207|쉬익!
208|
209|갈라지는 먼지구름 너머로 허공을 딛고 우뚝 선 한 사람이 모습을 드러냈다.
210|
211|언제나 속을 짐작할 수 없던 투명한 눈동자는 불길을 토해 내고 있었다.
212|
213|“진태경-!”
214|
215|누가 먼저랄 것도 없었다.
216|
217|나는 지면을 부수며 솟구쳤고, 그는 허공을 밟으며 내리꽂혔다.
218|
219|서로를 향해 휘두른 검과 창의 궤적이 정확히 맞닿은 순간, 어마어마한 충격파가 전신을 휩쓸었다.
220|
221|약속이라도 한 것처럼 동시에 튕겨 나간 우리는, 이미 폐허가 된 도시의 구조물을 밟으며 재차 쏘아졌다.
222|
223|쐐애애애액, 꽈앙!
224|
225|굉음과 함께 창날을 흘려 낸 검 끝이 곧장 목젖을 향해 찔러 들어왔다.
226|
227|펑!
228|
229|고개를 틀자 파공성과 함께 잘려 나간 머리카락이 흩날린다.
230|
231|하지만 이것으로 끝이 아니었다.
232|
233|쉬쉬쉬쉭!
234|

- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Prefer the best natural English analogy in the prose. Use a literal translation plus a concise footnote when the Korean wording itself matters. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.
- Never read `characters/spoilers/` during drafting. Reviewers may consult one relevant sealed profile only for a specific unresolved continuity issue after the draft is complete.
- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.
- Translate exactly one requested chapter unless the user explicitly requests a batch. Never modify Korean source files under `source/`.
